newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Investor proposes Barnevik as new chair.
newsitem.headline: Investor proposes Barnevik as new chair.

text.p: Swedish investment company Investor AB said on Thursday its chairman, Peter Wallenberg, has declined re-election and would be replaced by Percy Barnevik.
Investor is the investment vehicle of the powerful Swedish financier family, the Wallenbergs, headed by Peter Wallenberg.
The company said in a statement that Wallenberg and board member Tom Wachtmeister have declined re-election.
"The board of directors plan to appoint Percy Barnevik as chairman of Investor AB at the board meeting on April 14," the company said in a statement.
The recommendations will be put to Investor AB's annual general meeting that is also being held on April 14.
